title: External Validation Program
purpose: Prove Locaily externally with three programs: five unassisted developer testers on Lighthouse Handoff, authenticated two-device Relay pilot, and one second real workflow used for actual work.
problem: Internal architecture confidence exceeds external proof. Need real usage to expose setup friction, output quality, and repeat-use value.

included: Tester protocol and feedback template for 5 developers completing Lighthouse Handoff without maintainer help
Physical two-device Relay pilot runbook execution with authenticated LAN (using px2 gates)
Select and implement or harden one second real workflow for repeated work (e.g. a11y/SEO/repo analysis/test triage) — minimal viable, not a platform
Publish successes and failures as evidence artifacts under docs/04-validation or data/validation
Capture metrics: time to first output, completion rate, blockers, repeat-use intent
excluded: More than one additional workflow beyond the chosen second wedge
Changing core architecture based on single anecdote without evidence record

acceptanceCriteria.description: Protocol + materials exist; at least dry-run internally; results template ready for 5 external testers
Authenticated two-device pilot completed or blocked with explicit evidence and residual risks
Second workflow runnable and used at least once for a non-demo task with evidence
Successes and failures published as validation evidence, not only chat notes
